thread:
Aisha K: Hey team — trying to accept the org invite but GitHub says my work email (aisha@redwood.com) is already associated with a different account. The Accept button just redirects to my personal account. Can't do SSO or 2FA flow. Anyone seen this? :grimacing:
onboarding-bot: I see an open invite for aisha@redwood.com to the Redwood-org. If email is already tied to another account you'll need to either add the work email to your existing GitHub account and verify it, or ask admins to cancel & resend the invite to the account you're using.
Alice P: Hi Aisha — can you check Settings > Emails on GitHub to see which account has that address? If it's on your personal account you can add a secondary email (work one) and verify it, then use the invite link. If you don't want that, we can reissue to a different username. ping me if you want me to cancel and resend.
Aisha K: I tried adding the work email but GH won't let me verify because our org requires SSO and the verification email never arrives. Weird. Also the 'Sign in with SSO' button isn't showing on the invite page.
Ben R: Two quick options: 1) If you can log into your personal GH account, remove the work email from there, then accept the invite from your corporate account. 2) If you'd rather keep emails separate, tell Alice the username you want invited (your corporate acct username) and she'll resend. Also you'll need to add an SSH key to push — run:
```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "aisha@redwood.com"
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
```
then paste into GitHub Settings > SSH and GPG keys.
Devex: Note — sometimes GitHub blocks verification emails if you used an alias. Check spam + any forwarding rules. If you still don't get it, I can escalate to SSO team to check whether the org SAML settings are hiding the SSO button on the invite page.
Aisha K: Thanks — I did remove the work email from my personal account and then accepted the invite from the corp account. Got access to eng-runtime and can see private repos now. Will add SSH key in a bit. :party: 
InfraBot: The invite was cancelled and reissued by Alice P. org audit: user aisha@redwood.com added to teams: eng-runtime, dev-tools. Welcome! :tada:
Alice P: Glad that's sorted. I've added you to the GH team and to the onboarding checklist. If you run into repo perms (can't open PRs etc.) ping me.
Aisha K: All good — can push now after SSH key added. Thanks everyone!
